text: With m2 fixed on data_seed 1, read the N=64 seeds 20-21 at the checkpoint whose val_mse_ratio matches N=128 at step 3000 (0.049-0.054), using the same-layer (layer 4) probes_final control plus margin. Is the N=64 minus N=128 trained force R2 gap still at least 0.05, or does it shrink the way seed 20 did on data_seed 0 at 6000 steps?
